correctness.rationale: The published equilibrium and characteristic polynomial were independently reconstructed. After shifting to \(S_3\), the quadratic bilinear form was inserted into the standard center-manifold focal-coefficient formula. Exact simplification gives a denominator that is strictly positive, a residual polynomial \(P>0\), and numerator sign \(-abc(b^2-d^2)\). The source example was replayed from the packaged checker with exact symbolic arithmetic and gives a positive coefficient. The claim is limited to local stability and explicitly excludes the cubic-degenerate exceptional surfaces and all global attractor assertions.

value.rationale: The source uses a purely imaginary linear pair to call \(S_3\) a center. A nonzero cubic focal coefficient changes the local phase portrait qualitatively, producing slow attraction or repulsion instead of neutral closed curves. The exact sign criterion applies over an open parameter region and, at the source two-scroll parameter set, shows the nominal center is actually unstable. This materially sharpens local dynamical interpretation without relying on a global chaos claim.
